Shreya P: bringing up nova-13b (converted from fp16 -> int4) on staging. quick generation smoke shows fluency OK but systematic early-stops at ~120 tokens on summarization tasks.
Kevin L: interesting — same checkpoint and tokenizer? any vocab remapping during conversion?
Shreya P: yes using our standard convert script. no manual vocab edits. command: `python tools/convert_model.py --src nova-13b.fp16 --dst nova-13b.int4 --quant q4_0 --headwise-permute false`
Hao C: can you paste the eval command and a short failure example?
Shreya P: eval command: ```
python eval/generate.py --model path/to/nova-13b.int4 --prompt-file eval/summarize/nyt-100.prompts --max-tokens 256 --batch 8 --seed 42
```
Shreya P: example input: "Write a 3-sentence summary of the article about municipal budgets."
Shreya P: example output truncated: "Municipal budgets are under pressure due to rising costs. Officials are considering ..." then it emits ``

`` and stops (so EOS fired early).
Lex: that looks like an EOS token mapping issue. which tokenizer did you use? qwen-like byte-level vs gemma-wordpiece?
Shreya P: converter used `tokenizer=auto` which picked the bundled byte tokenizer from the checkpoint. the original fp16 model used a custom merged vocab in our repo though.
Kevin L: possible vocab id shift during conversion — int4 conversion pipeline re-serializes token tables, we had a bug where special token indices were remapped if the vocab length % 256 != 0.
Maria G: I saw a related one last month — nonzero pad sentinel in tokenizer metadata caused EOS aliasing when using new tokenizer serializer. can we diff the token id for ``");
Hao C: I ran a quick check: `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('vv.json'); print(t.token_to_id(''))"` fp16 -> 50256, int4 -> 50255 (off by one).
Shreya P: yep that explains it. how did id change happen?
Kevin L: root cause: our quant serializer drops trailing empty-token entries when length%128!=0, then `vocab.json` rebuilds with compacted indices. serializer fix is trivial, but we should patch convert script to sanity-check special token ids.
Lex: patch idea: after conversion, run a small check: map_specials = {"": src_id} and assert dst_id == src_id, otherwise remap or abort. also log warning.
Shreya P: agreed. meanwhile, does remapping require model weight edits? should be only tokenizer metadata change, right?
Hao C: only tokenizer metadata. but watch out: some generation loops use hardcoded EOS id in sampling code when model > 8k vocab; if index changed, that runtime would kill sequences. audit places that assume magic number 50256.
Maria G: we have a failing CI test that asserts `EOS == 50256` in `eval_runner.py`. I'll update to read from tokenizer object.
ci-bot: Build #4521 finished — tests: 421 passed, 1 failed (eval_runner.test_eos_binding) :red_circle:
Kevin L: ok patch plan: 1) fix serializer to preserve special-token indices; 2) add conversion sanity asserts; 3) update eval_runner to use tokenizer.eos_id(); 4) re-run int4 conversion and rerun the summarization smoke.
Shreya P: also saw a small PPL delta on wikitext subset: fp16 ppl=11.9 vs int4 ppl=13.7. not huge but noticeable. should we try `headwise-quant` vs `grouped-quant`?
Hao C: try `--quant q4_1 --headwise-quant` — headwise tends to preserve head geometry for rotary/attention and sometimes reduces downstream PPL at cost of slightly bigger size. also try `--rotary-scale 1.0` vs `0.9` if head dims differ from reference.
Lex: add a micro-benchmark: run 50-sample long generation (512 tokens) and compare token-level repetition/hallucination scores + timing. post results to this thread.
Shreya P: will run both conversions and post numbers later today. saving logs to s3://redwood-dev/triage/nova13b-int4-eval/3078901234/
Maria G: note for the changelog: mention "tokenizer index preservation" and "eval runner EOS fix". tag release notes.
Kevin L: after we fix tokenizer mapping, also run a smoke across Qwen and Gemma checkpoints — they sometimes hit different serializer paths leading to other off-by-one mappings.
Shreya P: thanks — will follow up with a short PR and the comparison table. :thumbsup:
Hao C: if anyone wants to reproduce quickly: conversion script is at `tools/convert_model.py` and the failing test is `tests/eval_runner/test_eos_binding.py`.
Lex: adding task in sprint board: ENGML-459 fix-int4-tokenizer-indexing
Shreya P: closing loop later with numbers.
